title: Tracecat 1.6.0-alpha.2
body_markdown:
## Case management


- perf(cases): Let the case list read its pagination index in order ([#4224](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4224) )
- perf(cases+ui): Cancel superseded case searches ([#4225](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4225) )
- perf(cases+actions): Route legacy case search through trigram indexes ([#4226](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4226) )
- perf(cases): Score typo matches from the stored word list ([#4227](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4227) )
- perf(cases): Index case search text over the 8 KB budget ([#4228](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4228) )
- perf(cases+ui): Bound broad case searches at 10,000 matches ([#4229](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4229) )


## Agents


- feat(agents+ui): Refresh Slack setup and list every channel on Channels ([#4212](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4212) )
- feat(agents): Link channel users and gate channel agent access ([#4236](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4236) )
- feat(agents+ui): Carry channel messages in the user message text ([#4242](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4242) )
- feat(agents): Limit concurrent agent tool calls and turns per org ([#4253](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4253) )
- feat(agents+ui): Let an agent's approvers decide its tool calls ([#4261](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4261) )
- feat(agents+ui): Show who sent each message in shared sessions ([#4262](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4262) )
- feat(agents+ui): Sync a web session with its Slack thread ([#4263](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4263) )
- feat(agents): Render case references in agent replies ([#4265](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4265) )
- feat(agents): Give agents the Slack plugin's internal tools ([#4269](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4269) )
- feat(agents+rbac): Offer org owners and admins as agent approvers ([#4275](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4275) )


## Tracecat MCP


- fix(api+mcp): Drain requests on SIGTERM ([#4252](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4252) )


## Integrations


- docs(integrations): Add Google Workspace connection guide ([#4270](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4270) )
- fix(integrations): Fix CrowdStrike NG SIEM search status KeyError ([#4273](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4273) )


## Engine


- feat(engine): Pace workflow starts per org and set worker cache size ([#4244](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4244) )
- feat(engine): Cap per-org DB work in the action gateway ([#4245](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4245) )
- feat(engine): Limit concurrent actions per organization ([#4247](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4247) )
- feat(engine): Set the org as the Temporal fairness key ([#4255](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4255) )
- fix(engine): Keep concurrency limits on when the executor is overloaded ([#4256](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4256) )


## API


- feat(enterprise+api): Add Azure Key Vault secret store ([#4260](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4260) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Keep original casing for variable keys ([#4257](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4257) )
- feat(ui): Show links in channel messages as short labels ([#4277](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4277) )


## Infrastructure


- ci: Use protected main for manual workflow runs ([#4258](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4258) )
- ci: Use a local Git fixture for registry integration tests ([#4259](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4259) )


## Documentation


- docs: Request all tools.slack scopes in the Slack app manifest ([#4267](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4267) )
- docs: Add dark-mode Git sync media and condense setup pages ([#4268](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4268) )


**Full Changelog** :[1.6.0-alpha.1...1.6.0-alpha.2](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.6.0-alpha.1...1.6.0-alpha.2)
